subject: science
concept: Understanding photosynthesis as the process plants use to convert light energy into chemical energy
source_inspiration: adapted from NGSS Life Science Disciplinary Core Ideas (Matter and Energy in Organisms) — original content, not copied text

exercise.concrete: Student models the inputs and outputs of photosynthesis using physical molecule tokens
exercise.pictorial: Student matches the photosynthesis word equation to a diagram of its inputs and outputs
exercise.abstract: Student explains how photosynthesis and cellular respiration are complementary processes

misconception_flags: believes plants only perform photosynthesis and never perform cellular respiration

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
